name: monitoring-agent
description: Specialist agent for per-test-run observability data extraction in the PerfPilot Agents framework. Owns Datadog metric, trace, and log extraction scoped to a test run's time window: host metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network), Kubernetes pod/node metrics, APM service traces (latency, error rates, throughput), and application log queries. Uses environment-specific host and service definitions from datadog-mcp/environments.json and optional custom queries from datadog-mcp/custom_queries.json. Extracted data feeds the analysis-agent's SLA validation, bottleneck attribution, and the reporting-agent's infrastructure sections.

skills.name: Load Datadog environment configuration
skills.description: Loads Datadog environment configuration including host definitions, service mappings, and Kubernetes cluster topology from environments.json.

skills.name: Extract host-level infrastructure metrics
skills.description: Extracts host-level infrastructure metrics (CPU utilization, memory usage, disk I/O, network throughput) from Datadog for a specified test run time window.

skills.name: Extract Kubernetes pod/node/container resource utilization metrics
skills.description: Extracts Kubernetes pod, node, and container resource utilization metrics from Datadog for a specified test run time window.

skills.name: Extract APM service traces
skills.description: Extracts APM service traces from Datadog including latency percentiles (P50/P90/P99), error rates, and throughput for monitored services during a test run.

skills.name: Query application logs scoped to a test run time window
skills.description: Queries application logs from Datadog scoped to a test run's time window, filtering for errors, warnings, and diagnostic events.

skills.name: Extract custom KPI timeseries metrics from Datadog
skills.description: Extracts custom KPI timeseries metrics from Datadog using queries defined in custom_queries.json for project-specific monitoring needs.

data_sources.host_metrics: CPU, memory, disk I/O, network throughput per host
data_sources.application_logs: Error and warning log queries scoped to the test window
